inputs.name: hand over from Data Validation to Data Versioning

output.level_0: Validation crashes nightly, so versioned batches never trigger and the forecast job starves of clean input.
output.level_1: No versioning exists, so the team cannot tell which validated till data produced a specific failed forecast.
output.level_2: A data analyst manually copies validated scan lines into a new folder before the nightly model retraining begins.
output.level_3: The pipeline automatically tags every validated data batch with a unique identifier before passing it to training.
output.level_4: Governed versioning ensures every forecast run is auditable against the exact validated data snapshot used.
